skills/clip.description: Cut a video into short-form clips (highlights/shorts) — cut given timecodes directly, or pick the best moments from a Perso AI STT project. Reframes 16:9→9:16. Subtitles are added separately by the srt skill.

skills/dubbing.description: Auto-dub (voice-translate) videos into other languages, with lip-sync (Perso AI Dubbing).

skills/srt.description: Extract subtitles (SRT) from video/audio/URLs and translate them into other languages (Perso AI STT).
